name: jamie-principle
synth_class: mono analog or virtual analog with square wave + ladder/OTA filter, played as a bass-lead (bass register but melodically)

patch_notes.oscillators: VCO 1 SQUARE 8' or 16' (bass register, not sub — you want to hear the harmonics)
patch_notes.filter: cutoff 25-40% (slightly open to hear the square's woody character), resonance 30-50% (snap, plucky)
patch_notes.envelope_amp: fast attack, full sustain, medium release
patch_notes.envelope_filter: fast attack, short decay (filter snaps closed), mid sustain, env amount 40-60% (filter follows envelope shape)
patch_notes.lfo: off — Chicago bass-leads use the arp itself for motion, not LFO modulation
patch_notes.arp_settings: 1/16 division, UP-DOWN mode, hold root + octave (e.g., C2 + C3) for the classic Chicago bass-lead bounce
patch_notes.performance: the magic is the arp + octave switch on the panel. Flip octave switches mid-song for breakdown/build moments. Filter slowly opens through the track.
